blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday shared that she had a “painful small talk” with senators when she went to the Senate on Thursday, emphasizing that being two-faced is a politicians’ national sport. This was the response of Duterte when she was asked about her visit to the Senate for the plenary deliberations of the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) for its 2027 budget. The OVP’s budget interpellation lasted for only two minutes with no questions asked about it.
